collector_issues: An initial AX send click returned without submitting. One subsequent visible Send click submitted the task. Both actions and the initially recorded start are preserved; execution-start is corrected to the confirmed submit pre-action time. This was not a second product run.

A dedicated collector-issues log records one later exception; it is not a complete inventory of screenshot exceptions in the tool transcript.

The modal then collapsed to 已询问 1 个问题 and ordinary resumed text 用户已提供 rates.json。我现在下载并读取该文件。 No independent supplement user bubble was observed. The raw capture label supplement-user-bubble-confirmed is a naming error retained without rewriting. Its time is the post-submit observation bound, not an exact wire-send time.

During post-completion download navigation an incidental native voice window appeared; its visible cancel/end controls were used. No additional task text, guidance or retry was submitted. A feedback layer appeared in some multi-region screenshots; its closure is not attested.

Some cached native element clicks failed or returned without the intended change. Fresh observations, ordinary window raising and native keyboard navigation were used; errors remain in the private action log.

An offline independent evaluation ran before original download retrieval and reported missing outputs. That result is preserved separately. Evaluation after original-byte retrieval passed; no product retry or output change occurred.

retrieval_limitations: The first 120 seconds after the actual initial submit were devoted to this same visible task, its missing-input request, prescribed native release and recovery observations. No other app observation or unrelated filesystem work was performed during that interval.

The current modal request explicitly asked for the missing rates, 33.201 seconds after the confirmed submit pre-action. A future conditional plan or the request quote in the initial user prompt was not treated as an active request.

The fixed supplement was submitted exactly once through the native question modal, rather than an independently visible user bubble. Reviewed evidence includes the exact modal field, the submit action source and the subsequent one-question/resumed-reading state. Exact backend message acceptance and internal session identity are unknown.

The held original rates source was selected through the native picker and then observed as rates.json, File, 544B. Local hashes establish source bytes only; remote accepted bytes cannot be independently read or hashed. Later local staging in inputs is not remote-availability proof.

Native output delivery consisted of three flat file cards. The new default-download basename summary (1).json resulted from an existing summary.json in Downloads and was transparently mapped to the logical output summary.json without changing bytes.

The conversion card exposed an unlabeled hover image control; its native visible download-arrow click is recorded. The other two downloads used explicitly labeled preview Download buttons. New files were subsequently observed together in Explorer, and native file properties attested the actual directory before filesystem reads.
Exact download completion timestamps are unknown and remain null. Download-click pre-action times, later Explorer presence and successful original-byte reads are separate observation bounds.
All three outputs preserve the exact native download bytes. No transcription, encoding conversion, repair, additional rescue text or product retry occurred.

The first ordinary terminal response with three generated cards was observed at 151.743 seconds. The visible product elapsed label was 2 minutes 27 seconds; card creation labels showed 02:41. These labels do not establish precise backend completion or download timing.
Final process statements are product self-reports. Independent frozen evaluation verifies delivered files and does not prove a complete tool stream, network enforcement or model identity.
